reasons: Cited Section 24 matches the preferred position: 24.1 gives Customer an affiliate/successor assignment right without Vendor consent (notice plus assumption only), 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment/change-of-control transfer to Customer's consent with a reasonableness standard and a competitor bar, and 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, re-pricing or fee-acceleration right on Customer's change of control.

Compliant status is correctly asserted with no redline and no comment, as expected for a clause meeting the preferred position; deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out is present.

Rationale accurately reflects the paragraph text and notes the document-wide sweep for hidden change-of-control triggers, so the finding is retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
